Name: anime portraits Sophia
Author: A1ZZM
Description:
Due to the SVE update, the anime portraits ohodavi edited by Champtwice don't look as good, especially with seasonal outfits. I added portraits
and repurposed them for seasonal outfits - a slightly cuter aesthetic for SVE.

I'm not trying to steal someone's work, I was just trying to solve the problem of Sofia's different portraits for myself.

Mods whose materials have been used (authors' permissions have been obtained) for compatibility with Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter
Aesthetic for SVE:
